### Investigação histórica

Groups: 4 · Skills: 16

[historicalInquiry.data.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/historicalInquiry/historicalInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Methods for establishing and checking knowledge of past societies through chronology, geography, source evidence, and historical inference. These competencies apply across ancient regions rather than defining a lesson sequence.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda como os historiadores investigam o passado e avaliam o que sabemos.

#### Explicações históricas

Skills: 4

[historicalExplanations.data.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/historicalInquiry/historicalExplanations/historicalExplanations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish supported facts, explanatory models, values, uncertain reconstructions, and competing interpretations when reasoning about the past.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda a construir explicações históricas com base em evidências.

##### Continuidade e mudança

[continuityAndChange.data.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/historicalInquiry/historicalExplanations/skills/continuityAndChange.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that institutions, practices, and traditions change at different speeds and can coexist.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Observe o que mudou e o que permaneceu nas sociedades do passado.

##### Causalidade histórica

[historicalCausality.data.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/historicalInquiry/historicalExplanations/skills/historicalCausality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate immediate triggers from long-term conditions and consider multiple causes of a historical change.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore por que os acontecimentos históricos geralmente têm mais de uma causa.

##### Comparação histórica

[historicalComparison.data.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/historicalInquiry/historicalExplanations/skills/historicalComparison.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare societies by explicit criteria without ranking entire peoples as inherently advanced or backward.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare sociedades com respeito, usando evidências relevantes.

##### Incerteza histórica

[historicalUncertainty.data.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/historicalInquiry/historicalExplanations/skills/historicalUncertainty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate well-supported conclusions from hypotheses and unknowns, updating interpretations when new evidence appears.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda o que os historiadores sabem, supõem ou ainda não conseguem determinar.

[historicalGeography.data.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/historicalInquiry/historicalGeography/historicalGeography.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore as oportunidades e os desafios dos ambientes antigos.
